generations.text: Leila Alvarez contacted support because the Volt Charger clicks and stops at 80 percent since 2026-02-16. It is a Low priority case and the status is currently Escalated. The agent offered a refund of $199.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-50921 and asked for a replacement. The knowledge base notes that Volt Charger units are exchanged within 18 months for latch faults. The customer seems satisfied with the proposed next step.
